title: Aggregate apiserver introspection requires aggregated discovery format for CRD groups
answers: Why are CRD resources from an aggregate apiextensions apiserver missing during router introspection under /apis?
How does the router discover API groups from an aggregate apiserver supporting aggregated discovery?
Why does router aggregate discovery fail to see CRDs on baas_apiserver?
body:
Symptom: Resources and CRD groups served by an aggregate apiextensions apiserver fail to introspect and do not appear under /apis.
Root cause: pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:discoverGroups sent discovery requests without an aggregated discovery Accept header, causing targets like baas_apiserver to return only static startup groups and omit dynamic CRDs.
Fix pattern: Request aggregated discovery (apidiscovery.k8s.io) ahead of application/json, check the Content-Type in pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:decodeDiscoveryResponse, and decode APIGroupDiscoveryList into classic metav1.APIGroup structures via pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups with fallback to metav1.APIGroupList.
Constraints: Applies when discovering resources from aggregate apiserver targets that manage dynamic CRDs; does not apply to forward backends which read groups from RouteBackend CRs.
applies: pkg/router active discovery of API groups from aggregate apiserver targets
